items.title: Hanke and Walker writing in @FortuneMagazine on the NEED FOR A NO BUDGET, NO PAY RULE: "The U.S. needs to adopt a No Budget, No Pay Rule. Such a rule would mandate that, if Congress does not pass all the appropriations bills by the end of the applicable fiscal year, its members must stay in session until they do so. Members of Congress would not be paid until they pass all the appropriations bills, and there would be no retroactive pay."
